review_notes: I read the whole file. It has no new definitions, structures or classes, only lemmas about the product σ-algebra, comaps and measurable embeddings. The generating-set lemmas (`generateFrom_prod_eq`, `generateFrom_eq_prod`, `generateFrom_prod`) are layered on one another: the specialised ones call the general one. `isPiSystem_prod` is a named specialisation of `IsPiSystem.prod`, which is defined in `Mathlib/MeasureTheory/PiSystem.lean`. Many downstream files use it, for example in `Measure/Prod.lean`, so the name is worth keeping. I grepped for competing declarations and found none. `comap_prodMk`, `comap_prodMap`, `MeasurableEmbedding.prodMap` and the `prodMk_left`/`prodMk_right` embeddings each have a single definition. The `measurableEmbedding_prodMk_left` and `MeasurableEmbedding.prodMk_left` pair is a specialisation and a general form, not a duplicate. The remaining overlap is only at the level of individual theorems, which the rubric excludes. I did not check Lean core or Batteries, since they have no measure-theory concepts. I found no justified finding.
